inputs.question: Assess this real counterparty within a bounded live scope.

agent.question: Assess this real counterparty within a bounded live scope.
agent.explanation: No public model credential is required. Intent routing is deterministic; chain reads, calculations, citations, and risk rules remain deterministic.

identity.explanation: EOAs do not have contract source code.

coverage.limits: get_logs pages are at most 1,000 blocks; this app requests three indexed event views per page.

analysis.question: Assess this real counterparty within a bounded live scope.
analysis.headline: LOW observed risk within the checked scope.

signals.name: Observed activity maturity
signals.explanation: No supported token activity was found in the bounded window. This is not proof that the address is new or inactive.
signals.limitations: Bounded indexed-event coverage; token implementations may be non-standard.

signals.name: Current approval exposure
signals.rule: FLAG when a discovered allowance remains effectively unlimited
signals.explanation: No standard Approval events owned by this address were observed in the checked range. Non-standard tokens and older approvals remain outside coverage.
signals.limitations: Bounded indexed-event coverage; token implementations may be non-standard.

signals.name: Rapid funding-to-outflow
signals.rule: Inbound then initiated outflow within 10 blocks
signals.explanation: No matching rapid receive-then-send sequence was observed in the checked range. Unsolicited inbound transfers alone do not trigger this flag.
signals.limitations: Bounded indexed-event coverage; token implementations may be non-standard.

signals.name: Counterparty pattern
signals.rule: FLAG at ≥ 80% across ≥ 3 outflows, or any chain-matched user watchlist exposure
signals.explanation: No configured watchlist exposure or concentrated initiated-outflow pattern was observed in the checked range.
signals.limitations: Bounded indexed-event coverage; token implementations may be non-standard.

coverage.limits: get_logs pages are at most 1,000 blocks; this app requests three indexed event views per page.

analysis.method: HIGH requires two independent flagged signal families; MEDIUM requires one; LOW requires zero and sufficient coverage. Data gaps never become LOW.
analysis.disclaimer: This is a bounded counterparty briefing, not a safety certification, criminal attribution, or scam prediction.
